sloka: समभूमितले रम्ये द्रुमैर्बहुभिरावृते ।पुण्ये रम्स्यामहे तात चित्रकूटस्य कानने ॥२-५६-११॥
transliteration: samabhūmitale ramye drumairbahubhirāvṛte ।puṇye ramsyāmahe tāta citrakūṭasya kānane ॥2-56-11॥

translations.english: O dear this sacred forest of Chitrakuta standing on a level land is full of various trees. Let us enjoy it.
